description: This Java class defines a data structure 'ConsumerData' that encapsulates information related to a JMS message consumer, including source, address, address with index, and the consumer object itself. It provides factory methods, getters, an override for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: ConsumerData
classes.description: A final class representing consumer data used in JMS messaging context. It encapsulates source, address, address with index, and the MessageConsumer object, providing utility methods for creation, access, and comparison.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ConsumerData with given source, address, address with index, and MessageConsumer.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the Source associated with this ConsumerData.

methods.name: getAddressWithIndex
methods.description: Returns the address with index string.

methods.name: getActorNamePrefix
methods.description: Constructs and returns a prefix for actor naming based on the source index and address with index.

methods.name: withMessageConsumer
methods.description: Returns a new ConsumerData instance with the same source, address, and address with index but a different MessageConsumer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare ConsumerData instances based on their fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() for hash-based collections, based on source, address, addressWithIndex, and messageConsumer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString() to provide a string representation including address and addressWithIndex.
